item.title: Toyota's 2027 WRC Prototype Looks Like Its Teasing a New GR Celica
item.description: Spotted racing around Portugal, Toyota's WRC27 prototype trades the Yaris's hatchback body style for a new coupe format.

item.title: Subaru Recalls 71K Hybrid Crosstreks and Foresters Due to Fire Risk
item.description: When the SUVs are parked in hot temperatures, a nearly full fuel tank can leak and pose a fire hazard.

item.title: View Photos of the 1988 Luxury Coupe Comparison

item.title: 1988 Luxury Coupe Comparison Test: Acura, BMW, Lincoln, or Mercedes?
item.description: From the archive: We make a high-speed dash across Florida in a quartet of desirable two-doors.

item.title: Jim Farley of Ford on Making a U-Turn on EVs and Flooring It with Off-Roaders
item.description: Five years into driving Ford, CEO Jim Farley talks to C/D about the tough road ahead of him and how he's navigating competition from China.

item.title: Two Racing Pettys Signed This 1992 Pontiac Grand Prix for Sale on Bring a Trailer
item.description: This Richard Petty Edition GP was signed by The King and also by Kyle Petty.

item.title: Your Guide to Buying a New Electric Vehicle in 2026
item.description: Considering taking the electric plunge? Read this to understand your options and how an EV purchase differs from that of a gasoline-powered vehicle—then check out Car and Driver's Marketplace to continue your shopping.

item.title: Attention Porsche Fanatics: The Air/Water Show Returns to California in April
item.description: No dividing lines between air-cooled and water-cooled 911s here, all are welcome.
